message_bundle.speaker: Iris Cole
message_bundle.text: We can bring trailer 48219 in on Tuesday June 9 around 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM. We need about a 90-minute door appointment.

message_bundle.speaker: Marcus Bell
message_bundle.text: Do not use the Tuesday suggestion. Receiving can only take this load on Wednesday June 10 between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Keep 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM blocked for the yard safety huddle. If Wednesday fills up, Thursday June 11 from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM is acceptable. For same-day unloading, the truck has to be checked in by 1:00 PM; anything later rolls to the next business day.

message_bundle.speaker: Iris Cole
message_bundle.text: Understood. We will work from the June 10 morning window and use June 11 only if June 10 is full.

message_bundle.speaker: Nadia Ruiz
message_bundle.text: We are lining up a freezer load for Monday June 15 and can make the gate any time after noon. The unload itself should take 60 minutes.

message_bundle.speaker: Devon Price
message_bundle.text: Please book this one on June 15 only, between 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM. Block 2:30 PM to 3:00 PM for the dock wash cycle and 4:15 PM to 4:45 PM for export inspection. Because the product cannot sit overnight, the appointment must stay on June 15. Same-day unloading requires arrival by 4:00 PM; later arrivals will be sealed and unloaded the next morning.

message_bundle.speaker: Pete Lawson
message_bundle.text: We first looked at Tuesday June 23 from 5:00 AM to 8:00 AM and we need a full two-hour dock slot.

message_bundle.speaker: Asha Grant
message_bundle.text: June 23 is closed for cycle count, so do not send the truck that day. The workable options are Monday June 22 from 5:00 AM to 7:30 AM or Wednesday June 24 from 5:00 AM to 7:30 AM. On June 24, leave 6:15 AM to 6:45 AM open for the gantry crane test. For same-day unloading, check-in has to happen by 7:00 AM; anything after that can wait on site but will unload the following day.

message_bundle.speaker: Mila Foster
message_bundle.text: We need a 45-minute cold-chain unload and are aiming for Wednesday July 1 if possible.

message_bundle.speaker: Jon Park
message_bundle.text: Preferred receiving window is July 1 from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM. If the reefer maintenance overrun pushes us, July 2 from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM is acceptable. Keep July 1 from 7:00 PM to 7:20 PM blocked for the alarm drill, and keep July 2 from 6:30 PM to 7:00 PM blocked for temperature calibration. Same-day unloading only applies if the truck reaches the gate by 7:30 PM; later arrivals stay in the cold queue until the next morning.

message_bundle.speaker: Mila Foster
message_bundle.text: Thanks. We will target July 1 first and fall back to July 2 only if needed.
